title: hotel
content: i’m extremely bad at explaining so i’m going to try my best. Has anyone been to a hotel and the lobby floor is shaped sorta like an octagon & the interior is a dark brown wood color. if you go further into the hotel there is a little cafe where you can eat indoor or outdoor? the restaurant colors are red, blue, and green I believe? theres also big elevator doors that are also a brown color. the elevators always take soooo long to arrive as well. there’s always valet men in a velvet maroon color outside the hotel that will help you with your bags or anything you need. also outside the hotel there’s a city & you can see a long bridge that takes you further into the city.
